P11.rationale: A before/after horizontal bar chart comparing response times (24h vs. 2 min) is present and bound to specific numeric data points on the right column.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a large portrait, structured text sections, a chart, and bold metric callouts, though the lower-right quadrant feels somewhat sparse.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white/cream background texture is present but very understated, providing minimal atmospheric differentiation from a flat page.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo has text overlaid (the '12-24h' label) which is part of the image itself, and no separate scrim is applied, but the photo is contained in a box rather than full-bleed so readability issues are limited.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real person from a specific business context (video-call/presentation setting with branded backdrop), reducing generic stock feel, though the image quality and context are somewhat ambiguous.

N08.rationale: The lower-right area below the testimonial quote block is largely empty, creating a noticeable dead zone, though the rest of the page is reasonably filled.

N10.rationale: The '12-24h' text sits directly on the photo without a scrim, but it appears to be part of the original image content rather than editorially placed overlay text, so the issue is minor.
